title: valuemap.update
description: This method allows to update existing value maps.

valuemapid.description: ID of the value map to update. Required for update operations.

hostid.description: Value map host or template ID.

mappings.description: Value mappings for the value map.

type.description: Mapping match type. For type equal 0,1,2,3,4 the value property cannot be empty, for type 5 value property should be empty. Possible values: 0 - (default) exact match; 1 - mapping will be applied if value is greater or equal (supported only for items having value type "numeric unsigned", "numeric float"); 2 - mapping will be applied if value is less or equal (supported only for items having value type "numeric unsigned", "numeric float"); 3 - mapping will be applied if value is in range, ranges are inclusive, allows defining multiple ranges separated by a comma (supported only for items having value type "numeric unsigned", "numeric float"); 4 - mapping will be applied if value matches regular expression (supported only for items having value type "character"); 5 - default value, mapping will be applied if no other match were found.

value.description: Original value. Is not required for mapping of type "default" (type 5).

newvalue.description: Value to which the original value is mapped to.

uuid.description: Universal unique identifier, used for linking imported value maps to already existing ones. Used only for value maps on templates. Auto-generated, if not given.
